body.p: The Content Reuse Finder view helps you locate similar content in your project or in topics referenced in the DITA Maps Manager view.
If the view is not displayed, you can open it from WindowShow View. By default, it appears in the top-right section of the editor.
The view includes the following options:

ul.li: Scope specifies the source scope for the search: Project, or specific project folder or DITA Maps Manager view.
Enter a list of element names that might contain similar content lets you restrict the search to specific element types.
Show similar content for the current file limits the results to the currently opened file.
Ignore stop words excludes common stop words like and or thefrom the similarity analysis.
Similarity threshold controls how closely content must match to be included in the results.
Find similar content starts the search.

body.p: Results are displayed in the Results view grouped by similar findings. If you double on each group of similar elements you can see in the same Results view a precise list of elements which are similar.
